create_VideoHungungarianMatcher: create a VideoHungarianMatcher instance with configurable cost weights for classification, mask, and dice losses
run_VideoHungarianMatcher_forward: run the VideoHungarianMatcher forward method to compute 1-to-1 matching between predictions and targets
run_VideoHungarianMatcher_forward_3d: run the VideoHungarianMatcher forward method with decoder_3d=True for 3D video mask matching
compute_batch_dice_loss: compute batch dice loss between predicted and target tensors for mask segmentation evaluation
compute_batch_sigmoid_ce_loss: compute batch sigmoid cross-entropy loss between predicted and target tensors for binary mask classification
